defs.def: to give sth to sb in exchange for money 出让；转让

ex.s: When Sonja Detrinidad opened her online shop selling houseplants, she didn’t have high hopes for it.
ex.t: 当索妮娅·德特里尼达开设了她的在线室内植物店时，她对此并没有抱太大期望。

ex.s: Even though Britain has a reputation for less-than-impressive cuisine, it is producing more top class chefs who appear frequently on our television screens and whose recipe books frequently top the best seller lists.
ex.t: 尽管英国以平庸的烹饪闻名，但它正在培养出更多一流厨师，他们频繁出现在电视屏幕上，其食谱书也经常登上畅销榜榜首。

ex.s: The Lord of the Rings was published in three volumes in 1954 and 1955, and has become one of the world's best-selling novel 2 Every Christmas, an envelope with a North Pole stamp arrived.
ex.t: 《指环王》于 1954 年和 1955 年分三卷出版，已成为世界上最畅销的小说之一 2 每年圣诞节，一封带着北极邮戳的信封都会如期而至。

ex.s: He is best known for his best-selling novel Jaws, which was later adapted as a film by Steven Spielberg.
ex.t: 他最出名的是他的畅销小说《大白鲨》，后来被史蒂文·斯皮尔伯格改编成电影。

ex.s: Now she is one of the world’s best-selling authors.
ex.t: 现在她是世界上最畅销的作者之一。

defs.def: to offer sth for people to buy 出售；售卖

ex.s: In the 1990s, a group of thieves often sold stolen goods with the help of some beggars.
ex.t: 1990年代，一群盗贼经常在一些乞丐的帮助下出售赃物。

ex.s: Wander among a variety of shops selling gifts while enjoying a live music show and nice street entertainment.
ex.t: 在售卖礼品的各类店铺间漫步，同时享受现场音乐表演和精彩的街头娱乐。

ex.s: It will be sold to the city government.
ex.t: 它会被卖给市政府。

ex.s: But Inglis ended up buying hundreds of them himself, with the idea of repairing and selling them.
ex.t: 但英格利斯最终自己买下了数百个，打算修理后出售。

ex.s: It’s sold at a discount price.
ex.t: 它以折扣价出售。

ex.s: After Lincoln was elected President of the US in 1861, they rented the house and   65   （sell）most of their furniture.
ex.t: 1861年林肯当选美国总统后，他们租了房子并____65____（sell）了大部分家具。

ex.s: If your supermarket sells loose produce, then buying smaller quantities is easier.
ex.t: 如果你的超市出售散装农产品，那么少量购买就更容易了。

ex.s: Fishermen go out to sea daily and sell their fish in harbor-side markets.
ex.t: 渔民每天出海，在港区市场售卖他们的鱼。

defs.def: to be bought by people in the way or in the numbers mentioned; to be offered at the price mentioned 销售得 … ；卖出 … ；售价是 …

ex.s: Selling food and drinks.
ex.t: 销售食品和饮料。

ex.s: Student A is selling a new mixed fruit drink.
ex.t: 学生A正在销售一种新的混合果汁饮料。

ex.s: Tom is proud of his design and excited to be selling the Fun Bottle on his website and in stores but this 15-year-old is most proud of the opportunities that Fun Bottle presents to others.
ex.t: Tom对他的设计感到自豪，也很兴奋能在他的网站和商店销售Fun Bottle，但这位15岁少年最引以为豪的是Fun Bottle为他人带来的机会。

ex.s: Afterwards, she and her father secured their first business meeting with a supermarket owner, who finally agreed to sell  Moore's product-Cancandy.
ex.t: 之后，她和父亲争取到与一位超市老板的首次商务会面，对方最终同意销售摩尔的产品Cancandy。

defs.def: to make people want to buy sth 促销；推销
to persuade sb that sth is a good idea, service, product, etc; to persuade sb that you are the right person for a job, position, etc. 推荐；推销；自荐；自我推销

ex.s: In addition to being venues for buying and selling, daji are occasions for socializing and entertainment.
ex.t: 除了作为买卖场所，大集也是社交和娱乐的场合。

defs.def: to accept money or a reward from sb for doing sth that is against your principles 出卖自己；卖身

ex.s: To sell home-grown vegetables.
ex.t: 为了卖自家种的蔬菜。

defs.def: to sell things cheaply because you want to get rid of them or because you need the money 甩卖；抛售；变卖

ex.s: When it was eventually published, the book became an immediate best-seller and went on to sell millions and millions of copies.
ex.t: 当它最终出版时，这本书立即成为畅销书，并最终售出了数百万册。

ex.s: My grandpa said last summer they earned quite a lot by sell the fish.
ex.t: 爷爷说去年夏天他们卖鱼赚了相当多钱。

defs.def: to sell all or part of an industry, a company or land 出售，卖掉（产业、公司或土地）

ex.s: Over the last two years, some supermarkets   62   (start) selling chicken or salad in packs   63   (design) with two halves containing separate portions (份).
ex.t: 在过去两年里，一些超市开始销售鸡肉或沙拉，包装设计成两半，分别装有独立的份量。

ex.s: her parents might regret selling their house
ex.t: 她的父母可能会后悔卖掉房子。

ex.s: But recently it has discovered that data can be turned into new services: translation and visual recognition, to be sold to other companies.
ex.t: 但最近它发现数据可以被转化为新服务：翻译和视觉识别，然后出售给其他公司。

ex.s: About that time, Tony Inglis’ engineering and transport company got the job to remove phone boxes from the streets and sell them out.
ex.t: 在成为许多英国街道的重要组成部分后，电话亭在1980年代开始消失，随着手机的兴起，大多数被送到了废品收购站。

ex.s: Terrafugia Inc said Monday that its new flying car has completed its first flight, bringing the company closer to its goal of selling the flying car within the next year.
ex.t: Terrafugia公司周一宣布，其新型飞行汽车已完成首飞，使该公司距离在未来一年内销售飞行汽车的目标更近了一步。

ex.s: Bradford sold the building and land to a local development firm, which plans to build a shopping complex on the land where the theater is located.
ex.t: 布拉德福德把大楼和土地卖给了当地一家开发公司，该公司计划在剧院所在的土地上建一个购物中心。

ex.s: Terrafugia Inc said Monday that its new flying car has completed its first flight, bringing the company closer to its goal of selling the flying car within the next year.
ex.t: Terrafugia公司周一宣布，其新型飞行汽车已完成首飞，使该公司距离在未来一年内销售飞行汽车的目标更近了一步。

ex.s: What made Georgia agree to sell some of her objects?
ex.t: 是什么让Georgia同意卖掉她的一些物品？

ex.s: The state also cleared the way for companies to sell or rent out self-driving cars, and for companies to operate driverless taxi services.
ex.t: 政策制定者现在应该开始思考如何确保自动驾驶汽车的出现不会延续我们当前受控于汽车的交通系统中最糟糕的方面。

defs.def: to change or give up your beliefs or principles 背叛信念；背弃原则
to sell your business or a part of your business 出售（财产、企业等）
